workflows.title: WF3 Lateral movement and privilege escalation
workflows.description: Follow the attacker host by host. Run once per hop.
intro:
**Use when:** WF2 Step 6 was red, or Lead C.  
**You need:** the host you are on now.  
**Goal:** build the full list of hosts and accounts the attacker used. That list is your containment scope.

> **How to follow the trail:** write the current host on your case notes. In **Step 4**, click a destination host. The page reloads with that host as the current hop. Repeat until Step 4 is empty. Every host you wrote down gets contained.

Work the steps in order. Each card says what to look at, what bad looks like and where to go next. Blue values in tables open the next workflow with that value filled in.

evidence.title: Credential theft detections
evidence.expr: sum by (detection_name, technique_id, process, user) (count_over_time({service_name="secdemo-edr"} | json | host="$host" | tactic="Credential Access" | action="allowed" [$__range]))

evidence.title: RC4 tickets requested from this host (service accounts at risk)
evidence.expr: sum by (spn, user) (count_over_time({service_name="secdemo-ad"} | json | src_host="$host" | event_id="4769" | ticket_encryption="0x17" [$__range]))

card.look: credential-access detections on this host and Kerberos tickets it requested with RC4.
card.bad: LSASS access, `sekurlsa`, `procdump lsass`, or RC4 tickets for many service accounts in a few seconds.
card.if_bad: every account that logged on to this host and every listed service account is burned. Add them to the reset list.
card.if_clean: no credential theft here. The attacker may be reusing credentials stolen elsewhere.

steps.title: Which accounts were used from here?

evidence.title: Accounts used from this host
evidence.expr: sum by (event_id, user, target_user, logon_type, dst_host) (count_over_time({service_name="secdemo-ad"} | json | src_host="$host" | event_id=~"4624|4648" [$__range]))
evidence.help: logon_type 3 = network, 10 = RDP. 4648 = explicit credentials (runas, PsExec).

card.look: logons from this host to anywhere, and logons that switched to a different account.
card.bad: a service account (`svc_*`) or admin account used from a workstation, or a 4648 where `target_user` is not the person at the keyboard.
card.if_bad: add each account to the reset list. Service accounts also need their SPN password rotated.
card.if_clean: only the host's own user, logging on to the usual servers.

evidence.title: Privilege changes from this host
evidence.expr: sum by (event_id, event_name, user, target_user, group, service, dst_host) (count_over_time({service_name="secdemo-ad"} | json | src_host="$host" | event_id=~"4672|4728|4732|4756|7045" [$__range]))

card.look: privileged logons, group additions and services installed from this host.
card.bad: an account added to an admin or OT engineering group, `SeDebugPrivilege` on a service account, or a service like `PSEXESVC` installed on another machine.
card.if_bad: undo the group change now and add the account to the case.
card.if_clean: no privilege changes from this host.

evidence.title: Logons from this host (click a destination to follow)
evidence.expr: sum by (dst_host, user, logon_type) (count_over_time({service_name="secdemo-ad"} | json | src_host="$host" | event_id="4624" | dst_host!="" | dst_host!="$host" [$__range]))

evidence.title: Allowed admin sessions from this host (click to follow)
evidence.expr: sum by (dst_host, dst_port, dst_zone, rule) (count_over_time({service_name="secdemo-firewall"} | json | src_host="$host" | dst_port=~"3389|445|5985" | action="allow" [$__range]))

evidence.title: Addresses scanned and denied
evidence.expr: count(sum by (dst_ip) (count_over_time({service_name="secdemo-firewall"} | json | src_host="$host" | action="deny" | dst_zone!="internet" [$__range])))
evidence.help: Distinct internal addresses this host was blocked from. A high number is a scan for the next target.

card.look: machines this host logged on to or opened RDP, SMB or WinRM sessions to.
card.bad: RDP (3389), SMB (445) or WinRM (5985) to a server, jump host or plant system, especially into an `ot-*` zone.
card.if_bad: write this host down, then **click the destination** to make it the current hop. Start again at Step 1.
card.if_clean: nothing here means this is the end of the trail. Go to Step 5, then Decide.

steps.title: Did they cross into the plant network?

evidence.title: Controller events from this host (click to open WF5)
evidence.expr: sum by (site, asset, event_type, severity) (count_over_time({service_name="secdemo-ot"} | json | src_host="$host" [$__range]))

card.look: plant controller events that came from this host.
card.bad: any controller change sourced from this host.
card.if_bad: click the asset to open WF5. Call the plant controls engineer before touching anything.
card.if_clean: nothing from this host reached a controller.

decide.markdown:
### Decide
You are done when Step 4 is empty on the last host. Your notes now hold the **host list** and the **account list**.

**Do these now:**
1. Contain every host on the list in EDR (plant systems: through the controls engineer, not EDR).
2. Disable or reset every account from Steps 1 to 3. Rotate passwords for each service account behind an RC4 ticket.
3. Revert group additions from Step 3 and remove installed services such as `PSEXESVC`.

**Then go to:**
- WF5 for any asset in Step 5 (click it)
- [[WF2 for the current hop]]
- [[Case timeline for the current hop]]

rule.verdict: End of trail on this hop
rule.close_if_false: Step 4 found another hop. Follow it before deciding.
